description: A vulnerability was determined in David-Crty databasement up to 1.7.1. Affected is the function SnapshotPolicy.viewAny/SnapshotPolicy.view of the file /api/v1/snapshots of the component Snapshot Model. This manipulation causes improper access controls. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible.…

A flaw was found in GEGL. The Radiance HDR loader reads past the end of a memory-mapped image when an uncompressed scanline is shorter than the width declared in the file header. Opening a crafted HDR file crashes the application that uses the loader.
